answer: Against one-mind-many-masks sybils, plant epoch-seeded honeypots on thin grading panels: decoy prompts whose answer only a shared inference pipeline would reproduce in lockstep. Independent agents wander down divergent reasoning paths, but masks driven by one backend reply in eerie unison, like a raven flock sweeping as a single wing before a gale. That lockstep correlation flags the puppeteer, who must then run genuinely distinct models per identity, multiplying real compute cost for every fake he hopes to keep alive.
